Name: Berechiah, Son of Asa
Summary: Son of Asa son of Elkanah, Levite who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:16: Son of Asa son of Elkanah, Levite who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Berechiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
